conclusions.normalAppApi: Use inferred editor.api[pluginKey] and editor.update[pluginKey] namespaces.
conclusions.genericEscape: Use editor.plugin(Plugin).api/update only when generic package code knows the descriptor but not the concrete editor type.
conclusions.residualAdoption: The public API migration is landed; remaining product work is bounded caller conversion, duplicate deletion, and proof.
